title: 14-Day Italy & Switzerland Grand Tour

day_ledger.highlights: Arrive Rome · Settle in Trastevere/Monti · Evening passeggiata, dinner at Da Enzo al 29
Ancient Rome: Colosseum + Forum + Palatine · San Clemente · Monti lunch · Capitoline Museums
Vatican early (7:30) · St. Peter's · Castel Sant'Angelo · Pizzarium
Train to Florence · Duomo + dome climb · Afternoon: Uffizi · Evening: aperitivo Negroni (invented here!)
Accademia (David) · San Marco frescoes · Medici Chapels · Mercato Centrale lunch
AM: Brancacci Chapel + Oltrarno · Afternoon: Day trip to Pisa (Camposanto, Cathedral, Cecina) · Return Florence
Train to Venice · Afternoon: San Marco + Doge's Palace (Secret Itineraries) · Sunset Zattere · Cicchetti dinner
Morning: Torcello + Burano · PM: Jewish Ghetto, Scala del Bovolo, Frari · Evening: Bacaro crawl Cannaregio
Train to Milan · Duomo + rooftop · Galleria · Last Supper (pre-booked!)
Sforza Castle (Rondanini Pietà) · San Maurizio frescoes · Brera · Luini Panzerotti
Bernina Railway to St. Moritz (scenic UNESCO ride!) · Arrive PM · Lake walk · Segantini Museum
Muottas Muragl sunrise · Sils Maria + Nietzsche House · Val Fex walk · Zuoz sgraffito
Return to Rome (via Milan) · Afternoon: Appian Way bike ride · Testaccio Market · Protestant Cemetery sunset
Borghese Gallery (morning slot) · Quartiere Coppedè · Final Aventine keyhole · Departure from FCO
